account:
It is just after ten on day 0, and I am at the plaza for my scheduled market walk. So far, town life looks ordinary. Townsfolk 28 and 18 reported that the baker was carrying wheat at the bakery; that fits bread-making and is not evidence of anything unusual. Townsfolk 08 and 30 had no news. I have a feeling something may be happening without my knowledge, but nothing I have heard establishes that yet.

The one unresolved matter is my three o'clock tea appointment with an unnamed neighbour at an unspecified dockside cottage on the east bank. The appointment book gives neither the host nor the particular cottage. The secretary also did not know and said she would confirm the details. This could simply be an incomplete entry for an ordinary social visit; I do not know who arranged it or whether it connects to anything else.

I should continue listening during my market walk, keep my noon lunch and one o'clock accounts appointments, and obtain the tea details before three. I have no grounds yet to identify a secret gathering, its participants, or its purpose.
